title: Eva Carneiro: José Mourinho Comments on Past Controversy
description: Portuguese media outlets report that José Mourinho has revisited the controversy involving former doctor Eva Carneiro.

sections.heading: Recalling the Controversy
paragraphs: According to Record, José Mourinho remembered the controversy with Eva Carneiro. The source highlights a statement regarding the equality of a female doctor to a male doctor.

sections.heading: A Dramatic Decision
paragraphs: A Bola reports that Mourinho revealed the most dramatic "no" of his career. The publication states that he did it "for love."

sections.heading: Media Attention
paragraphs: SAPO reports on a Netflix documentary focusing on Mourinho, describing him as psychologically a "monster" and "incredible."

faq.q: What did José Mourinho say regarding Eva Carneiro?
faq.a: According to Record, Mourinho recalled the controversy with Eva Carneiro, stating that a female doctor is equal to a male doctor.

faq.q: What is the context of the recent reports?
faq.a: A Bola reports that Mourinho discussed the most dramatic "no" of his career, which he did "for love," while SAPO reports on a Netflix documentary about him.
